rows.label: tlk42360112_04_msg0001
rows.name: Thanks for coming all this way, mo.

rows.label: tlk42360112_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Since you're here, I'll tell
you an interesting story, mo.

rows.label: tlk42360112_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Drivers should train their hearts
day and night to resonate with
superior Blades, mo.

rows.label: tlk42360112_04_msg0005
rows.name:
But when it comes to resonating,
only the strongest part of the
heart matters at all, mo!

rows.label: tlk42360112_04_msg0006
rows.name:
If courage is someone's strongest
trait, only courage affects
resonance, mo.

rows.label: tlk42360112_04_msg0007
rows.name:
The other three don't
matter at all, mo!

rows.label: tlk42360112_04_msg0008
rows.name: Heh heh heh, I finally said it, mo!
